title: To amend title 5, United States Code, to authorize the increase of the retirement age in the United States Capitol Police.
short_title: To amend title 5, United States Code, to authorize the increase of the retirement age…
subjects: Government employee pay, benefits, personnel management
committees: H-Committee on House Administration: Referred To 2026-04-20 -> Markup By 2026-04-22 || H-Oversight and Government Reform Committee: Referred To 2026-04-20
committee_votes: Committee on House Administration 2026-04-22: Ordered reported - 8-0
summary: This bill authorizes the Capitol Police Board to waive the mandatory retirement age for members of the Capitol Police up to age 65. (Under current law, a member of the Capitol Police is generally subject to mandatory retirement at age 57 but may receive a waiver from the board authorizing later retirement up to age 60.)

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
